an unrecorded write is run again
an unrecorded read blocks the run like a write
the next append is glued onto a torn record
a torn last record makes the whole journal unreadable
a reconcile 'done' runs the write again
approve signals are recorded but never applied
a run id reused with other input answers the old question
a run id can name a path outside the store
